items.name: Mapping tone in UI
items.note: A 2x2 for voice: how informational or instructional a moment is, against how much is riding on it, and which tone each corner gets.

items.name: Flowchart shapes
items.note: What each shape means when you map a flow: capsule for start and end, rectangle for a step, diamond for a decision, parallelogram for input or output.

items.name: Baby duck syndrome
items.note: People imprint on the first system they learn and judge every redesign against it, which is why a better UI can still get hated at launch.

items.name: Checklist Design
items.note: Checklists of everything a page, component or flow needs, for websites, web apps and mobile.

items.name: Design Patterns Catalogue
items.note: Patterns for services that handle people's data, and now AI: consent, transparency, control, trust.

items.name: The safe triangle
items.note: The prediction cone that keeps a submenu open while the pointer cuts diagonally toward it. macOS, Windows and Amazon all have one; most web dropdowns don't.
